text:
maya: Heads-up — Lynx customer private/VPC deploy window is booked for Thu 2026-03-19 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan is a rolling cutover across their two regions, low-traffic slice first.

aj: Confirming who's running the deploy and who has rollback?

maya: I'll be the primary deploy lead. kevin will be rollback lead and will run post-cutover smoke checks. tess will cover oncall and escalation. oliver will monitor networking + VPC peering.

kevin: I'll prepare the rollback snapshot and a short rollback script. Plan: if any region fails health > 5m, revert by restoring snapshot + routing back to standby.

aj: Are there any DB migrations during the window? Need to know for schema locks.

maya: No schema migrations. We have a config flip only (feature flag + endpoint switch). No DB downtime expected.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by maya for customer/lynx. CI: queued. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lynx-vpc-cutover (internal).

kevin: CI passed on staging. I'll attach the rollback checklist here before we start.

maya: Quick checklist for tomorrow:
- confirm preflight nodes healthy (kubectl get nodes)
- export current routing table (aws ec2 describe-route-tables)
- snapshot volumes (ami/snapshots) — kevin done before T-30m
- set feature-flag to canary for 5%
- monitor token-level latency + error-rate for 10m
- if OK, proceed to 50% then 100%

aj: Can we have a short smoke test script to run after each region flip?

maya: Yes, using the health endpoints:
```bash
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\"" https://lynx-api.prod.internal/health/ready
curl -sS -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN\" -X POST https://lynx-api.prod.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq -r '.text'
```

kevin: I'll run k8s rollout status and then the two smoke commands. If any HTTP >=500 or latency > 1.5s for 3 consecutive checks, we roll back.

tess: I'll be in the #infra-oncall channel and reachable by DM. Pager escalation at T+15m if errors persist.

oliver: Re: networking — I'll validate NAT/peering after cutover and watch for dropped connections.

infra-oncall: Reminder: ensure logs are being forwarded to splunk; set alert for 5xx surge and token-split anomalies.

maya: One more: config secrets rotation is NOT part of this window. Don't rotate kms keys.

aj: Got it. I'll be standing by for approval at T-15m to kick.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: all green. Canary tests: none run yet. Approvals required: maya, kevin.

maya: Approving now. kevin — go when ready at 02:00 UTC.

kevin: Starting canary at 02:00 UTC. Will post status after first region.

oliver: Network pre-check: peerings are in place, no IPSec churn in last 24h. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks everyone — will post updates here during the window. If we hit >5% errors we'll execute rollback plan.

aj: acked. Good luck :rocket:

kevin: First region canary complete — 5% traffic, 0 errors, latency median 320ms. Moving to 50%.

maya: Nice. Keep the updates coming.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: canary -> 50% completed. Metrics: CPU 62%, p95 latency 780ms.

kevin: 50% done, small 502 spike right after rollout, recovered within 30s. Continuing to 100%.

kevin: 100% traffic, all healthy. Closing window at 02:28 UTC.

maya: Post-deploy note: no rollback required. Please file a short postmortem if you saw anything unusual.

aj: filing quick notes now.

mike: (joined channel) congrats team, thanks for the smooth run. :tada:
